name: Chimera Universal Boot Contract
goal: Accept kernels from native or chainloaded BIOS/UEFI, Multiboot1/2, Limine-compatible, profile-specific mobile boot paths, and virtual-machine CD/DVD firmware without assuming a particular hypervisor implementation.

handoff.failure_policy: fail_closed_to_diagnostics_or_recovery; never launch userspace when initramfs root validation fails

initramfs_contract.handoff: only after transactional CPIO validation and required-file checks
initramfs_contract.limitation: Koronos does not yet interpret shell scripts or execute /init directly from the CPIO VFS; the selected ring-3 target ELF is launched as a separate validated module.

display_contract.native_koronos: framebuffer/GOP text and registered display drivers; no production native X.Org/Wayland server yet
display_contract.hosted_linux: X.Org X server with XDG xsessions and Wayland compositor sessions

endianness.boot_context: All fixed-width numeric fields in CHMBOOT1 are little-endian; byte arrays and strings are uninterpreted bytes.
endianness.real_mode: x86 real16 is little-endian; other architectures follow their own ISA. Firmware mode alone does not imply a universal endian setting.
endianness.transition: Record and revalidate endian state across real16 -> protected32 -> long64 transitions and on handoff to Koronos.
endianness.compatibility: Guest ABI byte order is distinct from host byte order; decode at the boundary.
endianness.emulation: Emulator must implement guest-visible loads, stores, instruction fetch, MMIO and exceptions using guest architecture semantics.
endianness.unknown_policy: Reject unknown or unsupported endian profiles for executable/kernel images.
